title: Kenworth K200 FUPS Bullbar with Road Train signs #13
description: Kenworth K200 high tensile aluminium FUPS Bullbar, full depth channel with vents to cool oil cooler & spotlight mounts allow maximum clearance from back of light to cab. 88mm pipes, main pipes are one piece passing through drilled heavy duty 100mm wide uprights. Heavy duty tow pin in steel backing plate. Flip over combination aluminium Road Train-Over Size signs. Chrome plate tow hitch cover. Heavy duty mesh for maximum driving light protection. Combination daylight running/indicator repeater lights are mounted in the outer uprights.
